name: Alarm Drum
summary: An alarm setter with 3D number drums you flick, that coast, tick and settle, then drop the time into your list
about: A phone alarm screen built around three real drum pickers for hours, minutes and AM or PM. Drag one and it turns like a cylinder under your finger; flick it and it coasts with friction, ticks past every number and springs to rest inside the lens. Setting an alarm swings the bell, flies the time down into a new card that opens up in the list, and works out when it really rings next from today's date and the days you picked.
how: Drag a drum up or down, or flick it and let it coast; with a mouse you can also scroll over a drum.
Pick the days to repeat and type a label, then press Set alarm: the time drops into a new card that switches itself on.
Tap an alarm's time to load it back into the drums, which spin round to it; use its switch to turn it on or off.
Press the Next alarm pill to preview the ring. After you touch the page the drums also tick softly.
Keyboard: Tab to a drum and use the up and down arrows, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End.
